obligations.source_text: A random complex investigative architectural photograph that tests whether an intentional body-bounded negative space appears as a clean, continuous patch of background between an adult woman's arm and waist, while using the supplied portrait only for facial appearance.

bindings.body_boundaries_phrase: two or more real body contours bound the opening: her right arm contour and her waist contour
bindings.continuous_background_phrase: continuous background visible through the opening as one unbroken patch of pale plaster wall
bindings.void_shape_phrase: an intentional enclosed negative-space shape, specifically a crisp triangle
bindings.body_region_phrase: the arm-waist region remains plainly identifiable
